spec_match.rationale: A/B of auto vs none on real two-axis scrollers, with the honest caveat that locking applies to gestures only (script scrolls are never locked) stated on the page.

interactive.rationale: Both stages genuinely pan (touch/wheel/keyboard), every scroll sample is plotted on a canvas trace, and clear resets both traces.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises measured traces (L-shape vs diagonal); the page delivers exactly that visualization.

edge_cases.rationale: Unknown-property engines get the flag note predicting two L-shaped traces — the genuine pre-153 behavior, not an error.

conformance.rationale: The suite's gesture-lock-disabled manual assertion names this page's trace comparison as its procedure.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: script-driven scroll path produced 10 plotted samples and correct readouts; clear worked; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read. Real gesture locking cannot be exercised headlessly and is not claimed.

telemetry_health.rationale: sal-stage-init asserts with the support flag; scroll sampling is passive and console-quiet.

design_system.rationale: Trace stroke uses --accent-blue on bg-stone; terrain grid built from theme colours; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Both pans are labelled focusable regions (keyboard-scrollable); canvases carry descriptive aria-labels; readouts are text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Duo grid collapses under 760px; the oversized terrain scrolls inside its own container; 0px page overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000; touch-action pan-x pan-y keeps stage gestures scrolling the stage.

openQuestions.title: Capture the diverging traces with a real gesture on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: Axis locking only affects real gestures, which a headless harness cannot produce. On touch or trackpad hardware with Chrome 153, draw the same curve in both stages and confirm auto locks (L trace) while none follows the curve.

guidanceConsulted.query: focusable scroll region keyboard operation canvas labels
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Scroll regions need names and focus; canvases need text alternatives.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Regions have tabindex/role/aria-label; each canvas has an aria-label describing what it plots; numeric readouts duplicate the state in text.

guidanceConsulted.query: scroll event sampling passive listeners canvas redraw
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep scroll handlers passive and bound in work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Listeners are passive; the sample buffer is capped at 600 points.

guidanceConsulted.query: two card comparison grid mobile collapse
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Duo grid is 1-column under 760px; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the trace plumbing, readouts, and clear control all work on Chromium 141 via scripted scrolling, with the gesture-only nature of locking honestly stated. The real-gesture divergence needs hardware + Chrome 153 and is the open question.
